(SMG) is a UK based SME spin-out of Cambridge University that leads in high-precision MEMS inertial and gravity sensors, delivering unmatched accuracy, compact design, and low power consumption. Our resonant MEMS technology surpasses conventional solutions, driving advancements in autonomous navigation, space, aerospace, and subsurface exploration. Backed by over a decade of research and a growing patent portfolio, SMG is redefining motion and gravity sensing for the future.

For inertial navigation, SMG Motion develops high-performance, next generation MEMS sensors for inertial navigation, tilt sensing, and seismology. SMG offers low drift, low noise, high accuracy and sensitivity accelerometers and gyroscopes manufactured in silicon utilising our resonant MEMS technology. These take MEMS technology into the navigation grade arena with the potential to displace larger and more costly FOGs. Focus market segments for applications include Space and Aerospace.

For gravity sensing, SMG Gravity has developed as prototype gravity sensor for surface applications which has a sensitivity of 10 nano-g. The sensor has a form factor and power consumption which makes it suitable for deployment in space and the company has provided quotes for lunar missions.

Podkrižnik combines research excellence, engineering expertise and industrial manufacturing capabilities to support the development of innovative, high-performance technological solutions.

entityDescription:
S&N Invent is a nationwide IT company with a comprehensive portfolio of services covering the entire value chain of the IT lifecycle—from consulting and software development to managed services. We work with our clients to develop solutions, implement projects, and thereby create digital value.
We have focused on high-performance, scalable, and flexible enterprise architectures with modern software design. Using agile development processes and based on a technically sound requirements analysis, we create software in short development cycles with an exceptionally short time-to-use. Through continuous, methodical consulting in the areas of Continuous Quality Management and Software Development Governance—combined with agile methods—we ensure our projects are always future-proof.
Our range of expertise extends from classic mainframe architectures to modern Java/JEE web and portal architectures, all the way to the latest technologies in the cloud and mobile sectors.
Our service portfolio is complemented by consulting and development in the latest SAP technologies for optimized production, logistics, and warehouse management, as well as efficient supply chain solutions, including the corresponding service processes.
Agile projects with high quality standards, ensured by modern Continuous Quality Management, are the standard we uphold in numerous projects.
A key industry focus is the financial sector. Here, in addition to up-to-date and innovative technological expertise, we offer industry-specific architectural and solution know-how, e.g., for branch infrastructures and self-service-based cash management. This is underpinned by outstanding banking expertise, which has positioned the company for years as the preferred consulting, solutions, and service partner for numerous renowned financial service providers. Successful products—including those for credit management and balance sheet analysis, insurance management, and solutions for optimizing cash processes—round out our finance-specific offerings.
S&N Invent GmbH is a company of the S&N Group and its strongest operating unit. The S&N Group AG comprises S&N Invent GmbH, S&N Abiscon GmbH, 4YOU Abiscon GmbH, S&N Marktsoft GmbH, and IT Finance Consulting GmbH—each with its own technological focus, industry expertise, and applied methods. In total, the companies of the S&N Group employ over 500 full-time employees across ten locations. 
This puts us in an excellent position to serve our clients with comprehensive expertise and regional proximity. At the same time, it enables us to successfully implement large and complex projects on time and within budget.
